# Cola Documentation Index (offline snapshot)

## English

- [Changelog](/en/index): Cola desktop release notes, latest 1.4.3 (2026-09-03)
- [Account, Usage, and Models](/en/account-subscription-and-models): Understand how your Cola account, balance, Token Plan subscriptions, and model tiers fit together, and which actions are billed separately.
- [Memory and Preferences](/en/memory-and-preferences): Learn what Cola remembers, how to transfer or edit memory, and how memory differs from settings.
- [Network, Proxy, and Updates](/en/network-proxy-and-updates): Troubleshoot Cola login, model, and automatic update issues, and configure network access responsibly.
- [Voice Input and Shortcuts](/en/voice-input-and-shortcuts): Give Cola tasks by voice, use the command palette to run actions quickly, and adjust shortcuts.
- [Channels and Plugins](/en/channels-and-plugins): Install, connect, and manage channel plugins in Cola — how WeChat, Feishu, and Telegram each connect, plus installing local plugins and managing them from the CLI.
- [CLI](/en/cli): Use the Cola CLI to send tasks, check status, and troubleshoot.
- [MCP](/en/mcp): Connect MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to Cola — edit servers.json, complete OAuth, and how tools get discovered and called.
- [Plugin SDK](/en/plugin-sdk): Build Cola plugins — channels, LLM-callable tools, and cross-session observers.
- [Plugin Session Events](/en/plugin-session-events): Observe Cola agent execution from a plugin through the typed runtime.events surface.
- [Awareness](/en/awareness): Awareness is the trace your conversations leave on Cola — the growth tree that shows how its understanding of you builds up, the imprints it writes at night, and the moments it thinks of you on its own.
- [C Space](/en/c-space): C Space is the main screen you see when Cola opens — weather wallpaper, click-to-talk voice input, and the reply bubble.
- [Cola](/en/chat): The main conversation space — everyday tasks, questions, and collaboration all happen here.
- [Projects](/en/coding-cola): Cola's coding workspace — read code, edit files, run commands and tests, with every change visible in the files, changes, and diff panes.
- [Cola Skill](/en/skills): Discover and install skills from the Cola Skill site (colaskill.com) — how single skills and collections install, how failures surface, and how to manage and toggle what's installed.
- [Smart Alarms](/en/smart-alarm): Hand a future action to Cola in one sentence — it remembers, fires on time, does the work, and delivers the result where you asked.
- [Files, Attachments, and Outputs](/en/files-attachments-and-outputs): Learn how to give files to Cola, limit file scope, and find generated results.
- [Privacy and Local Data](/en/privacy-and-local-data): Understand what Cola stores locally, when cloud services are used, and what to check before sharing logs.
- [Tasks and Permissions](/en/tasks-and-permissions): Understand what Cola may access while running tasks, when confirmation is needed, and how to control file and external actions.
- [Backup, Migration, and Uninstall](/en/backup-migration-and-uninstall): Before changing computers, reinstalling, troubleshooting, or uninstalling Cola, understand which data is local and what needs manual handling.
- [Troubleshooting](/en/troubleshooting): Fix Cola startup, login, voice, model, and task execution issues, and where to report bugs.
- [Getting Started](/en/getting-started): Install Cola, sign in, and ask your first question.
- [Overview](/en/overview): What Cola is and what these docs cover.
- [Supported platforms](/en/platforms): Which platforms Cola runs on — system requirements and chip architectures for the macOS and Windows desktop apps, what the iOS and Android apps are for, and how to reach Cola from channels like WeChat or from a terminal.

## 中文

- [更新日志](/zh/index): Cola 桌面端版本更新记录，最新 1.4.3（2026-09-03）
- [账号、订阅与模型](/zh/account-subscription-and-models): 了解 Cola 账号、余额、Token Plan 套餐和模型档位之间的关系，以及哪些操作会单独计费。
- [记忆与偏好](/zh/memory-and-preferences): 了解 Cola 会记住什么、如何迁移或修改记忆，以及记忆和设置有什么区别。
- [网络、代理与更新](/zh/network-proxy-and-updates): 排查 Cola 登录、模型和自动更新的网络问题，并按合规方式配置网络环境。
- [语音输入与快捷键](/zh/voice-input-and-shortcuts): 使用语音向 Cola 交代任务，使用命令面板快速执行操作，并调整快捷键。
- [渠道与插件](/zh/channels-and-plugins): 在 Cola 中安装、连接和管理渠道插件：微信、飞书、Telegram 各自怎么接入，以及如何安装本地插件和用 CLI 管理。
- [CLI](/zh/cli): 使用 Cola CLI 发送任务、查看状态和排查问题。
- [MCP](/zh/mcp): 把 MCP（Model Context Protocol）服务器接入 Cola：编辑 servers.json、完成 OAuth 授权，以及工具如何被发现和调用。
- [Plugin SDK](/zh/plugin-sdk): 编写 Cola 插件：渠道、LLM 可调用 tool、跨会话观察者。
- [插件 Session 事件](/zh/plugin-session-events): 通过类型化的 runtime.events 接口，在插件里观察 Cola agent 的执行过程。
- [觉知](/zh/awareness): 觉知是 Cola 被对话改变的痕迹：觉知树展示它对你的理解如何积累，心迹是它每晚写下的随想，还有它主动想起你的时刻。
- [C 空间](/zh/c-space): C 空间是打开 Cola 看到的主屏：天气壁纸、点击即说的语音入口和回复气泡。
- [Cola](/zh/chat): 默认的对话空间：日常任务、问答和协作都发生在这里。
- [项目](/zh/coding-cola): Cola 面向编程任务的工作区：读代码、改文件、跑命令和测试，改动实时体现在文件、变更和 Diff 面板里。
- [Cola Skill](/zh/skills): 在 Cola Skill 技能站（colaskill.com）里发现和安装技能：单个技能与技能集合的安装行为、安装失败排查，以及已装技能的管理和开关。
- [智能闹钟](/zh/smart-alarm): 用一句话把一个未来的动作交给 Cola：到点提醒你、检查状态、生成结果，并把结果送到你要的地方。
- [文件、附件与输出](/zh/files-attachments-and-outputs): 了解如何把文件交给 Cola、如何限定文件访问范围，以及生成结果在哪里查看。
- [隐私与本地数据](/zh/privacy-and-local-data): 了解 Cola 在本机保存什么、什么时候会访问云端，以及分享日志前要注意什么。
- [任务与权限](/zh/tasks-and-permissions): 理解 Cola 执行任务时会访问什么、什么时候需要确认，以及如何控制文件和外部操作。
- [备份、迁移与卸载](/zh/backup-migration-and-uninstall): 换电脑、重装、排障或卸载 Cola 前，先理解哪些数据在本机，哪些需要手动处理。
- [故障排查](/zh/troubleshooting): 处理 Cola 启动、登录、语音、模型和任务执行问题，以及从哪里反馈 Bug。
- [快速开始](/zh/getting-started): 安装 Cola、登录账号，并提出第一个问题。
- [概述](/zh/overview): Cola 是什么，文档涵盖什么内容。
- [支持的平台](/zh/platforms): Cola 支持哪些平台：macOS 和 Windows 桌面端的系统要求与芯片架构，iOS 和 Android 移动端的定位，以及在微信等渠道和终端里使用 Cola 的方式。
